{{Quote|Funny place to put an Imperial capital.''"<br />"''Oh, I don't know. It was a sector capital once, so they're probably used to having a bureaucracy underfoot.''"<br />"''Still a long way from the glittering towers of Coruscant.|[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]]|<ref name="Vision of the Future">''[[Vision of the Future]]''</ref>}}
'''Bastion''', originally '''Sartinaynian''', was an industrialized [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Sartinaynian system]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] world of the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]], the continuation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Bastion was located in the [[Braxant sector/Legends|Braxant sector]] at the terminus of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|trade route]] known as the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]].

Originally, "[[Bastion (code name)|Bastion]]" was just a term for the worlds on which the [[Council of Moffs/Legends|Council of Moffs]] were temporarily located. Its last location remained a closely guarded secret by the time of the [[Caamas Document Crisis]], where the Imperial Remnant was located on Sartinaynian shortly before peace with the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] in [[19 ABY/Legends|19 ABY]].

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]], Bastion was [[Battle of Bastion|attacked]], resulting in the loss of the world to the Yuuzhan Yong, who took control and almost destroyed Bastion as they took a hold of the Outer Rim.

It was later rebuilt and became the capital world of the [[Fel Empire]], a successor state, and later the headquarters of [[Roan Fel]]'s [[Empire-in-exile]].

==History==
[[File:Bastion.jpg|thumb|left|250px|A military emplacement on Bastion.]]

During the [[Old Republic era]], the planet had originally been settled by [[Human/Legends|Humans]] who opposed alien membership in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]] became the financial muscle behind this human colony, with the [[Council of Banking Clans]] simply shrugging off such prejudices. Eventually, the Republic would integrate both [[Planet/Legends|planets]] as well as the other worlds on the [[Braxant Run/Legends|Braxant Run]].<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>

Both planets would remain loyal to the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]], and the continuing leverage enjoyed by Muunilinst could be seen by that world's refusal to surrender one of its defensive [[Golan space defense platform|Golan battlestations]] to guard Bastion. Instead, the capital was orbited merely by the [[Bastion customs station]].

Bastion was in [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] space during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Atlas" />

Like its predecessors, it served as the meeting place for the Moff Council and the site of the state archives, the civil administration, and [[Bastion Military Control]]; but the Imperial leadership strove to keep the precise location of this new Bastion as secret as possible to prevent the New Republic mounting a direct assault on their command facilities, so the fact that Sartinaynian was Bastion was not initially widely-known. Following the [[Pellaeon–Gavrisom Treaty|Bastion Accords]] that ended the Galactic Civil War, the Imperial Remnant no longer required a mobile, secret capital; thus, Sartinaynian remained the Imperial capital and became increasingly well-known in this role, so that the name of Bastion became permanently associated with the planet, eclipsing its old name.

In addition to serving as capital of the Imperial Remnant as a whole, Bastion also served as the throne world for the Imperial [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the Braxant sector, namely Moff [[Vilim Disra]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], and his successor, [[Ephin Sarreti]], during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. While Disra had been appointed a Moff by [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], Sarreti was a young man whom had never even met Palpatine, and was not as enmeshed in Palpatine's prejudices, making him a more popular leader in the progressive, "reformed" Imperial Remnant.

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong]] invasion, Bastion was [[Battle of Bastion|attacked]] by forces under the command of [[B'shith Vorrik]]. Vorrik destroyed the planetary defenses and the bulk of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial fleet]] there, as well as much of the surface of the planet. Fortunately, the fleet was able to buy enough time for most of the planet's population to evacuate before it was defeated.

[[File:Imperial_Headquarters.jpg|thumb|right|225px|The Imperial Headquarters on Bastion]]

Bastion was rebuilt, continuing to serve as the [[Fel Empire|Imperial]] capital until their recapture of Coruscant. [[43 ABY|Two years after]] the [[Second Galactic Civil War]] had ended, Bastion was the world that had represented the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial Remnant]] during the [[Unification Summit]] by [[Jagged Fel]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. By [[130 ABY]], it was said to be the most fortified planet in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

In [[137 ABY]], Emperor [[Roan Fel]] reclaimed the planet as a base of operations against the usurper to the Imperial throne, [[Darth Krayt]]. He drew [[Empire-in-exile|loyalist forces]] to the planet, in order to further ensure its protection against [[One Sith|Sith]] attack. The planet's nigh impenetrable defense systems made Bastion as well defended as [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], which prevented any direct assault on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="LECG" />

Despite Bastion being a fortress world, [[Darth Kruhl]] was still able to get on-planet when [[Governor/Legends|Governor]] [[Vikar Dorn]] of [[Munto Codru/Legends|Munto Codru]] pretended to defect to Fel's faction of the Empire. Kruhl made it all the way to the [[Pellaeon Gardens]], where Fel had been meditating. It was there that Fel killed him. After the incident non-Imperials were no longer allowed to visit Bastion, as the threat to the Emperor was too great. The Sith, however, still tried to find a way to infiltrate Bastion and so they offered a million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to anyone who could penetrate the planet's defenses. Following the [[Battle of Coruscant (Second Imperial Civil War)|end]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War|Second Imperial Civil War]], Bastion would come under the jurisdiction of the [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]]. 

Unlike most of the [[Planet/Legends|worlds]] in the [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], the Imperial occupation of Bastion had lasted for the duration of all 157 years of the Galactic Empire's existence, remaining loyal until the end. <ref name="LECG" />
